text: The largest tree-cover loss event on this property occurred in **2020**, with a loss of **67.7 hectares**. This event is the most significant recorded in the available data, which spans from 2001 to 2025. Other notable losses include **25.5 hectares in 2015** and **4.8 hectares in 2017**, but neither matches the scale of the 2020 event. The data is sourced from the **Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC-2025-v1.13)** dataset, which tracks changes at a 30-meter resolution.
